messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — preparing lockfile + submodule bumps for the 0.23.0 cut. Can folks confirm their PRs are merge-ready? I want to gate the merge window at EOD PST.
Maria: Working on vendor bump for storage client, should be ready in ~2h. main change is grpc -> 1.49, no API changes but CI flaked once locally. :crossed_fingers:
Jordan: FYI I saw a flake in model-serving tests with the new grpc. I can reproduce with `make test-serving` — stacktrace points to stream handling. Investigating.
Sanjay: If that hits CI consistently we should pin vendor in the lockfile and add a follow-up to investigate root cause post-cutoff. We can't block the whole release on a flaky transitive.
Priya: Changelog nudge — remember to add brief entries for dep bumps. Small bullets only: why we bumped and any customer-visible fixes. I can massage copy after merges.
CI Bot: build/1901234575: storage-vendor-bump #3287 — failed on unit-tests/test_streaming.go (see logs: https://ci.redwood/test/3287)
Maria: Thanks @CI Bot. I pushed a temporary revert that pins grpc to 1.48 in the vendor patch: `git checkout -b vendor/grpc-pin && git add vendor && git commit -m "pin grpc 1.48"` — opening PR now.
Alex: Good approach. @Jordan please confirm that reverting vendor fixes the test before we merge. If it does, we'll merge the pin as a temporary measure and log a follow-up ticket.
Jordan: Confirmed locally — pin fixes the test. Still want to file an issue: grpc stream behavior regressed on long payloads. I'll create ISSUE-1429 and link the failing trace.
ReleaseBot: Reminder: cut-off for branch `release/0.23.0` is in 8 hours (190123 + 8h). No breaking API changes after cutoff.
Sanjay: We should also run a smoke of the Dedicated infra before cut. Suggested quick commands: 
```
# quick smoke
make build-binaries
./bin/smoke --region=us-west1 --short
```
Maria: Running smoke now on staging. Will paste results.
Maria: Smoke finished, all green except one warn about tls cert rotation that doesn't affect this bump. Pushing PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3299 (vendor pin).
Alex: Great. Two asks before I merge: 1) Add a changelog line (Priya can follow up), 2) Add a short note in PR body about temporary pin and link ISSUE-1429. After that I will merge and kick the release pipeline.
Priya: I'll add the changelog line and QA checklist. Tagging QA owners for a targeted smoke: @Sanjay @Jordan.
Jordan: Will run a quick staging run after merge to validate KV cache paths.
CI Bot: build/1901234682: vendor-pin-pr #3299 — pending checks.
Alex: If CI passes, I'll merge at 17:30 PST. If anything else pops up, post here with short status. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maria: Ack, will monitor CI.
Sanjay: Also, if anyone touches submodules: remember to update submodule SHA in release branch and run `git submodule update --init --recursive` locally before merging. Small PR checklist reminder.
Jordan: Noted. I'll also add a brief entry in the release notes about temporary downgrade of grpc if we keep the pin.
ReleaseBot: Cutoff alert in 2 hours. Plan merges accordingly.
Alex: Closing loop — merging now that CI is green. Will follow up with the post-cutoff rollout plan in #eng-releases.
CI Bot: build/1901234708: vendor-pin-pr #3299 — success.
Alex: Merged. Thanks everyone. Follow-up items: ISSUE-1429 (investigate grpc stream regression), CHG-0.23.0 (changelog updates), and a small postmortem if the regression impacts customers.
Priya: I'll open the changelog PR in a few mins. :sparkles:
